@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The director's new film has received w______d praise. Both critics and the public enjoyed the film greatly, and more and more people are going to see it.
= widespread
~詞義 widespread（adj.）普遍的
~原文 The director's new film has received widespread praise. Both critics and the public enjoyed the film greatly, and more and more people are going to see it.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The singer's performance became the h______t of the festival, drawing enthusiastic applause from the entire audience.
= highlight
~詞義 highlight（n.）最精采處
~原文 The singer's performance became the highlight of the festival, drawing enthusiastic applause from the entire audience.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The dress is made of delicate and expensive f______c, so you should wash it by hand instead of using the washing machine.
= fabric
~詞義 fabric（n.）布料
~原文 The dress is made of delicate and expensive fabric, so you should wash it by hand instead of using the washing machine.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: John made a p______e of a brand-new laptop because his old one had finally stopped working.
= purchase
~詞義 purchase（n.）購買
~原文 John made a purchase of a brand-new laptop because his old one had finally stopped working.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The actress gave a touching speech at the awards c______y, and everyone in the audience clapped loudly for her.
= ceremony
~詞義 ceremony（n.）典禮
~原文 The actress gave a touching speech at the awards ceremony, and everyone in the audience clapped loudly for her.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Jake slowly ______ himself to the colder weather after moving to a northern city.
A: accommodated
B: fragmented
C: interpreted
D: gathered
= A
~詞義 accommodate（v.）適應
~原文 Jake slowly accommodated himself to the colder weather after moving to a northern city.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The oil spill from the cargo ship is a(n) ______ disaster; many seabirds and marine animals have died because of it.
A: ecological
B: exceptional
C: indifferent
D: statistical
= A
~詞義 ecological（adj.）生態的
~原文 The oil spill from the cargo ship is a(n) ecological disaster; many seabirds and marine animals have died because of it.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The woman asked her son to run some ______ for her and gave him an apple as a reward afterward.
A: bureaus
B: errands
C: layers
D: series
= B
~詞義 errand（n.）差事;跑腿
~原文 The woman asked her son to run some errands for her and gave him an apple as a reward afterward.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The hundred-year-old building has become a symbol of ______ in the district. You must see it if you ever go to that region.
A: ecology
B: assessment
C: heritage
D: shortage
= C
~詞義 heritage（n.）遺產
~原文 The hundred-year-old building has become a symbol of heritage in the district. You must see it if you ever go to that region.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Maggie seldom lets her dog ______ into unfamiliar parts of the neighborhood because she is afraid that it would get lost and never return.
A: assess
B: erect
C: perceive
D: venture
= D
~詞義 venture（v.）冒險
~原文 Maggie seldom lets her dog venture into unfamiliar parts of the neighborhood because she is afraid that it would get lost and never return.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: behalf
B: massive
C: participants
D: viewers
E: opponent
F: specializes

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: Dylan is a lawyer who ______ in civil law, especially family law.
= F
~詞義 specialize（v.）專攻
~原文 Dylan is a lawyer who specializes in civil law, especially family law.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: The computer can process a(n) ______ amount of information in a very short period of time.
= B
~詞義 massive（adj.）大量的
~原文 The computer can process a(n) massive amount of information in a very short period of time.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: Serena is such a powerful and experienced player that anyone would be fearful of being her ______.
= E
~詞義 opponent（n.）對手
~原文 Serena is such a powerful and experienced player that anyone would be fearful of being her opponent.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: The manager had a full schedule, so he had his assistant attend the meeting on his ______.
= A
~詞義 behalf（n.）代表
~原文 The manager had a full schedule, so he had his assistant attend the meeting on his behalf.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: The new talk show has attracted many ______. It is now one of the most popular shows on the network.
= D
~詞義 viewer（n.）觀眾
~原文 The new talk show has attracted many viewers. It is now one of the most popular shows on the network.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: specialty
B: perception
C: via
D: banned
E: granted
F: flipped

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: If you have any questions, please contact me ______ email. I check my mailbox every day.
= C
~詞義 via（prep.）透過
~原文 If you have any questions, please contact me via email. I check my mailbox every day.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: The man finally ______ his children's wishes and bought each of them a new laptop.
= E
~詞義 grant（v.）同意
~原文 The man finally granted his children's wishes and bought each of them a new laptop.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: Sarah ______ through the book and quickly browsed the chapter titles; she decided to buy it.
= F
~詞義 flip（v.）瀏覽
~原文 Sarah flipped through the book and quickly browsed the chapter titles; she decided to buy it.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: After the legalization of same-sex marriage, the public's ______ of the gay community gradually changed.
= B
~詞義 perception（n.）觀念
~原文 After the legalization of same-sex marriage, the public's perception of the gay community gradually changed.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: The school ______ students from using phones in class to reduce distractions and improve concentration.
= D
~詞義 ban（v.）禁止
~原文 The school banned students from using phones in class to reduce distractions and improve concentration.
